notes.title: Bug Fixing
notes.content:
The issue of cleaners not being able to reach the trash under the tables has been resolved.
The problem of not being able to clean the vomit on the platform has been resolved.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5 has been released !
notes.content:
Patch v1.0.5 has been released! Here are the updates:

A system has been added to rotate the Ferris Wheel in response to complaints about ticket checking. You can interact with two rotation buttons found on the control desk to rotate the Ferris Wheel left or right, making ticket checking easier.
The issue of garbage falling under tables at food stands and being unable to clean it has been fixed.
Collider issues with fences surrounding machines have been fixed. This eliminates the obstacle of being unable to move or sell machines from outside the fence.

notes.title: Patch v1.04 has been released!
notes.content:
Patch v1.0.4 has been released! Here are the updates:

4 new platforms have been added. You can purchase these platforms from the decoration store or FFShop and place them as you like. You can place them under all purchasable items to further beautify your park.
Repair Robots have been added to the game for automatic repairs. You can acquire the robots from the "Techbot Store," formerly known as the "Cleaning Store," and FFShop. They will automatically repair any machine when its health drops below 50%. Each of the 3 robot levels offers a different discount on repairs, with only the 3rd level providing free repairs.
A new skill called "Collection Ability" has been added for automatically collecting your earnings.
A signboard has been added to allow you to open and close the park. With this signboard, you can easily manage tasks like park arrangement by opening and closing it whenever you need.
The frequency of customer arrivals has been increased.
The required score to achieve a 5-star park has been reduced from 1.5m to 300k.

notes.title: Customer Count Increased
notes.content: I recently increased the parking lots but forgot to increase customer count. So with this update it just fixed!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3 has been released!
notes.content:
Patch v1.0.3 has been released! Here are the updates:

Fixed an issue with the Casino mission. Now, even if you buy shares before the mission, it will be considered completed.
The machine breakdown effect will start when the health drops to 50% and other effects will start at 25% health.
Prices for machine tickets, purchase, repair, and worker price have been changed.
When machines are sold, their value will decrease based on their remaining health.
Changed the "Buy a new parking space" email to only be sent once per day.
Made machines earn money silently when operated by worker, and added a mechanism to automatically adjust and operate the machine based on the customers average fear level.
Added a warning email before stocks and machine health are completely depleted.
Added a "Are you sure?" tab when hiring worker.
Added a "Stocks" section to the tablet.
Added an option to enable or disable collisions with customer cars. It will default to off, but you can enable it in the settings.
Added 30 new parking spaces. Additional rotation fixes and more parking areas will be added in the next update.

notes.title: PATCH v1.0.2 !
notes.content:
Patch v1.0.2 has been released! Here are the additions:

Grass no longer appears within the items you purchase. If an item is moved or sold, the grass will reappear.
Fixed an error on the repair screen.
Fixed an error on the end-of-day screen.
Extended the duration of the text that appears when activating the Easter egg, as it was closing before it could be read.
Implemented a counter for the number of customers caught in the ticketless customer-catching task. The count now continues into the new day without resetting, and catches by your worker are also counted.
Corrected the V-Sync checkbox in the main menu.
The minimum time for flirting has been reduced from 19:00 to 17:00, and flirting error messages have been improved.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
With the new patch 
-Endless ride bug fixed
-Pirate Ship money bug fixed

notes.title: FINALLY OUT
notes.content: Finally! My game is now available on Steam in early access version! Also, it's launched with a 20% discount for the first 14 days. You can add it to your library now before the discount ends! Don't forget to share your feedback on my Discord server!

notes.title: LAST UPDATE BEFORE EARLY ACCESS
notes.content: Hello dear players! Today, after a long development process, I am pleased to present an update to the demo version prior to early access. With this demo, we've introduced multi-language support (a few more languages will be added later) and several new features (the biggest being the flirt system). Playing this version and reporting any bugs you encounter will help ensure a smooth release in early access. The early access version with full language support will be released on next Friday.
